sim.w.elems: Elemental mods (combined in pairs from the top)
sim.r.head: Riven conditions
sim.r.curse.head: Negative stat
sim.presets: Mods (press for ON, again for OFF; max-rank values)
sim.note: These are estimates. Base Warframe and weapon stats come from the official Public Export (ExportWarframes / ExportWeapons); mod values, Riven base values and ability numbers come from public sources such as the WARFRAME Wiki. They can change with game updates, so adjust the inputs as needed. DPS does not include enemy armor, shields or weak points, status damage, combo multipliers, or special firing of charge/burst weapons.
sim.nodata: No simulator data yet. Fetch it with "Data Update" in the menu or the button on the right (needs an internet connection).
sim.fetching.log: Fetching. This can take a few tens of seconds...
sim.abil.head: Ability stats
sim.abil.ref: Abilities (enter a base value to estimate it with mods)
sim.f.note: Effective health = health ÷ (1 − damage reduction) + shields. Damage reduction = armor ÷ (armor + 300). Ability numbers (damage, range, etc.) are not in the official data, so enter base values you looked up on the WARFRAME Wiki or similar (inputs are saved in this PC's browser).
sim.w.note: Base damage: {list}. The weapon's innate elements are added after the elemental mods and combine with them.
sim.w.other: Not in this category. Found in:
sim.r.spliced: Spliced stats (one at most, positive only)
sim.r.title: Ranges ({group} / disposition {dispo} / rank {rank})
sim.r.note: Value = base × disposition (fixed 1.2) × stat-count modifier × random (0.9–1.1). At rank r, × (r + 1) ÷ 9. Modifiers for this setup: positive ×{buff}{curse}. Base values are from the WARFRAME Wiki (checked 2026-11-03). Kitguns use pistol values and companion weapons use rifle values. A spliced stat counts as one of the positive stats.
sim.g.head: Riven stats
sim.g.paste: Choose a screenshot of the in-game Mods screen or the screen right after a reroll, or paste (Ctrl+V) / drop it here. Reading uses Windows' built-in OCR.
sim.g.read: Read {n} stats. Fix them below if anything is wrong.
sim.g.read.none: Could not read any stats. Enter them below.
sim.g.weapon.none: Could not read the weapon name. Pick the weapon or the Riven type.
sim.g.unknown: Text that could not be paired: {list}
sim.g.hint: Enter values as shown in game. Negative stats take a -; for recoil, the positive stat is the - value. Enter faction damage x0.56 as -44 (x1.45 as +45).
sim.g.title: Grade ({group} / Rank {rank})
sim.g.total.part: (average without the stats out of range)
sim.g.out: ? means out of range. Check the weapon, type, rank, stats and values for misreads (screenshots from before the fixed 1.2 disposition are also out of range).
sim.g.note: Offset = how far, in %, the value is from the middle of its range (-10 to +10). {grades}. Negative stats are better when smaller, so their direction is flipped (except recoil). Overall is the average offset.
sim.lead: Calculates Warframe survivability and ability stats, weapon damage and DPS, and Riven stat ranges. All values are estimates.
